svg.aria-label: ricky g. Cloud and AI Solution Architect, Auckland, New Zealand. Engineer at heart. The hard part isn't creating AI. It's governing it. A layered policy shield links cloud, AI-agent and tool nodes through identity, policy and audit above the Auckland skyline.
